description: Put saved leads (prospect ids from list_prospects) into a sequence. Leads already in a sequence, dismissed, or who replied are skipped. If the sequence is running, the first call returns what will be sent and needs confirm: true. Without LinkedIn connected and a sending schedule on, the leads wait in the sequence until start_sequence.

confirm.description: Set to true only after the user agreed to what the first call (without it) said would happen.

name: add_leads_to_sequence
title: Add saved leads to a sequence
